caption: The drawing features the colored profile of a male head and partial neck and upper shoulders, rendered in brown, beige, and black hues. The head is seen in left profile, showing detailed features such as an outlined nose, lips, ear, and a dark, full beard that follows the jawline and chin. The hair on the head is thick and dark, styled back, and the ear is distinctly drawn. There are subtle hints of shading in blue and pink on the face, and vertically running lines suggest a wood-like texture on the neck and scalp. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or decorations. In the lower right corner, there is text in green ink that reads "Mabel G. Clarlin - TABI - I.A.M."
title: Bulto
